headline: FIS Stock Down Nearly 48% From 52-Week High: Is a Rebound Ahead?
summary: FIS stock has plunged nearly 48% from its 52-week high, but rising free cash flow, expanding margins and acquisition synergies could fuel a potential rebound.

headline: Jack Henry To Provide Tokenized Deposits Under Expanded Partnership With Google Cloud Through Universal Ledger
summary: Jack Henry® (NASDAQ:JKHY) today announced an expansion of its collaboration with Google Cloud designed to pave the way for banks and credit unions to offer tokenized deposits through Google Cloud Universal Ledger
